assessment: Fresh independent review of this new run against its frozen 805-line source packet and the original Supplementary Figure S5 finds the selected matched pair source-closed and eligible for drafting. The card faithfully encodes the two cyan fits reported at fixed m=1 and g^2=15: for the superposition-of-superselection-sectors initial state, S_SS(t)=2.94(2)log(t)+1.33(3), and for the gauge-invariant initial state, S_GI(t)=0.386(6)t+0.43(2). The caption identifies the measured quantity in both panels as time-averaged half-chain bipartite entanglement entropy in base two, while line 767 defines the averaging window Delta t=2.5. Visual reinspection of Fig. S5 confirms that the logarithm in the SS fit is natural: at t=2 the fitted value is about 3.37, matching 2.94 ln(2)+1.33 rather than the base-two alternative 4.27; 'base two' qualifies the entropy units, not log(t). The reviewer figure addendum supports the conservative common axis-interior query interval t in [2,5] and correctly avoids claiming exact regression-sample endpoints or a raw grid. Both oracle ASTs were independently materialized only from parameters reachable through their selected mechanisms and executed at t=2, 2.25, 3.5, 4.75, and 5. The SS outputs were 3.3678527108462393, 3.7141348356760067, 5.013123127376382, 5.910945177056857, and 6.061747462556255; the GI outputs were 1.202, 1.2985, 1.781, 2.2635, and 2.3600000000000003. Every value agreed exactly with the independently evaluated source formula. The two branches differ throughout all five checks and are non-degenerate. Coefficients and parenthetical uncertainties are transcribed correctly, while source_unspecified properly avoids inventing their confidence convention; the Oracle represents the reported fitted central curves rather than raw observations or a stochastic ensemble. The shared public interface is now exactly t to time_averaged_half_chain_entropy in both worlds. The previous branch-specific-readout defect is fully closed: the card has one readout, both claims name it, and both oracle_outputs maps expose that same key, while S_SS and S_GI remain only source notation. Common conditions are N=8 with PBC, m=1, g^2=15, the hardcore-gluon truncation, the half-chain entropy definition, and Delta t=2.5 averaging. SS_initial_state and GI_initial_state are disjoint source-anchored private conditions. Every selected locator supports its claim, parameter, statistic, domain, or condition; no formula, coefficient, logarithm basis, unit, domain, fit semantic, condition partition, source identity, or locator drift was introduced. The exact reviewed card contains no unresolved source ambiguity, and the pair is eligible_for_drafting.

review_material.assessment: The source provides a quantitative study of disorder-free localization (DFL) in a non-Abelian SU(2) lattice gauge theory. The best quantitative cluster is the entanglement entropy scaling in the SS and GI sectors at fixed mass m=1 and gauge coupling g^2=15, with fits S_SS = 2.94(2) log(t) + 1.33(3) and S_GI = 0.386(6) t + 0.43(2). This provides a numeric control (time t), a single shared numeric readout (time-averaged half-chain bipartite entropy), quantitative mechanisms (logarithmic and linear growth), and an explicit domain (t in [2,5] from reviewer evidence). The case is authoring-ready.

review_material.paper_scope: The paper investigates dynamical phases of a (1+1)D truncated SU(2) lattice gauge theory with dynamical matter, focusing on disorder-free localization (DFL), Hilbert space fragmentation (HSF), and ergodic behavior. It uses exact diagonalization on an N=8 site chain with periodic boundary conditions, and studies matter imbalance, quark populations, and entanglement entropy scaling.

The cyan dashed lines correspond to (a) the linear fit of the (g^2=15) GI curve S_GI=0.386(6)*t+0.43(2) and (b) the logarithmic fit of the (g^2=15) SS curve S_SS=2.94(2)log(t)+1.33(3).
